issues: asset_note: Log-log plot of flexibility factor k vs h, with five labeled curves: (1) Asymptotic Solution 1.65/h (Clark-Reissner), (2) Beskin's Large-radius results, (3) Symonds and Pardue's Small-radius result, (4) Von Karman's nth Approximation, (5) Approximate 1.20/h^(2/3) (Vissat-Del Buono) for small-radius thick-walled bends. Caption visible below plot.
